name: yt-x
title: yt-x
description: The yt-x menus in the launcher: feeds, library, channel tabs, search filters, playlist actions and downloads.
author: black

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Browse YouTube
commands.description: Search YouTube as you type, browse the yt-x feeds and library, and play or download with yt-x's own commands.

preferences.name: upNext
preferences.title: Play Up Next
preferences.label: Keep playing the related videos
preferences.description: On: Play starts the video and the personal related list as one playlist. Off: Play starts the video alone. Play with Up Next always starts the list.
